prompt: Design a polished, realistic native Android conversation app screenshot, a single full portrait flat screen, 412x892 dp proportions, no device casing, no poster, no surrounding scene. App Series 76 is an engineering assistant for actuator specifications. The user explicitly wants the familiar refined conversation-first pattern of Claude and Gemini, including a left slide-out conversation-history drawer, NOT an oversized dashboard or large generic cards. Original brand lilac #BD7BFF is only an accent; neutral near-white #FAFAFC main canvas, softly tinted grey #F0EFF4 sidebar and composer, charcoal #25232A text, darker grey #66616F secondary text, dark lilac #4C315E actions. Contemporary precise Android system sans typography with delicate hierarchy, no gigantic headlines. Top bar compact, hamburger at far left, Series 76 centered, a native new-conversation edit icon on the right. Main composer is an elegant large rounded soft-grey surface anchored above navigation inset, placeholder 'Ask about an actuator', a small round dark-plum upward-send-arrow button inside the right edge. No microphone, attachments, model selector, user profile, search, folders, projects, subscriptions, settings, voice, fake buttons, or added capabilities. Exactly actual chat and saved conversations, plus developer debug only off-screen in development. System Android status and gesture bars legible dark on light. No copied Claude/Gemini logo or star symbol. Content minimal but product-specific; this is a credible focused product, not a blank wireframe. Strong craft, careful 20dp gutters, thin separators only where meaningful, restrained shadows, readable 48dp controls, generous negative space. State THREE: populated conversation, drawer CLOSED. Top bar hamburger, compact title '110 V actuator selection', new conversation edit icon. User question right aligned in a pale neutral rounded bubble: 'Show the specifications for 761A00-11300000/A'. Assistant answer flows directly on the background with a small Series 76 attribution and text 'Published catalogue data is shown below.' Below, one elegant technical result surface, thin border and moderate 16dp radius, with full code '761A00-11300000/A', subtitle 'Weatherproof · 110 V AC · 1 phase', and disciplined aligned label/value rows: 'Motor power' / '15 W'; 'On/Off torque' / '80 Nm'; 'Modulating torque' / '65 Nm'. Source line 'Source: electrical catalogue · page 1', small text action 'Source notes & exceptions'. Do not invent more values, metrics or claims. Composer at bottom ready for a follow-up, keeping response open and airy. Product card is a useful technical artifact within a conversation, not a screen full of widgets.
